proof.text: Choose the residue characteristic and a coefficient subring Λ using exists_coefficient_subring. Transfer completeness to its maximal ideal. If Λ is not a field, its principal maximal ideal (p) is nonzero, p is irreducible, and separatedness bounds the order of every nonzero element. Induction on the bound divides nonunits by p until a unit remains. Apply the DVR unit-times-power factorization criterion to obtain IsCohenRing p Λ. These are the private helpers factor_of_bound and field_or_cohen.

Choose a finset of parameters by Ideal.exists_finset_card_eq_height_of_isNoetherianRing, enumerate it by Fin, and identify the cardinality with ringKrullDim. The quotient is Artinian and therefore some maximal-ideal power lies in the parameter ideal. In the Cohen case apply this to R/(p), lift all parameters along the quotient map, and pull back the ideal containment using comap_map_of_surjective. Since p is nonzero in the domain R, the nonzerodivisor quotient dimension formula gives dim(R/(p))+1=dim R. These are parameters and residue_parameters.

Evaluate formal power series using exists_ringHom_of_isAdicComplete with the given maximal ideal of R, the coefficient-subring inclusion, and the selected parameters. They all lie in that maximal ideal, so no change of completion ideal is needed. Give R the algebra structure induced by this ring map; evaluation fixes every constant and sends each variable to its chosen parameter.

Use the kernel of constantCoeff from quotient_first_variables to express the source maximal ideal as the sum of the coefficient maximal ideal and variable ideal (power_series_maximalIdeal). Map this equality through evaluation. Its extension I is contained in the target maximal ideal and contains a power of it. Mathlib IsHausdorff.of_map transfers target maximal-ideal separatedness to the source action; the source dimension equality is already supplied by residue_parameters.

For each element of the target residue field, use surjectivity of the coefficient-subring quotient map and choose a representative in Λ. Evaluation of its constant series gives the same residue class. This proves surjectivity for the constructed parameter map.

In finite_reduction, any prime containing I contains the target maximal ideal since a power of that maximal ideal lies in I. Thus the maximal ideal is a minimal prime over I and R/I is Artinian local. Identify its maximal ideal with the image of the target maximal ideal. The residue-surjectivity just proved makes its quotient by the Jacobson radical a surjective image of the source and hence a finite source module. Apply IsSemiprimaryRing.finite_of_isArtinian. Use Ideal.smul_top_eq_map and Submodule.Quotient.restrictScalarsEquiv to identify R/I with the displayed module quotient, and Module.Finite.of_restrictScalars_finite to pass to the source residue field.

title: Residue-preserving same-dimensional parameter map
statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] complete local integral domain, complete for its maximal ideal [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. There exist a natural number n, a commutative coefficient ring Λ which is a field or a Cohen ring [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring], a local-ring structure on A = Λ[[X_1,...,X_n]] [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], and an A-algebra structure on R, such that dim A = dim R [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], the intersection of all submodules m_A^k R is zero, and R/(m_A R) [def-weil-pbc-quotient-module] is a finitely generated A/m_A-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Moreover, the composite $A \to R \to R/\mathfrak m_R$ is surjective. No finiteness of R over A and no injectivity of A → R is assumed.

lean.statement:
theorem complete_local_domain_residue_parameter_map
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsAdicComplete (maximalIdeal R) R] :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (Λ : Type u) (_ : CommRing Λ),
      ∃ (_ : IsLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ))
        (_ : Algebra (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ) R),
        (IsField Λ ∨ ∃ p : ℕ, IsCohenRing p Λ) ∧
        ringKrullDim (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ) = ringKrullDim R ∧
        IsHausdorff (maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ)) R ∧
        Module.Finite
          (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ ⧸ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ))
          (R ⧸ (maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ) • ⊤ :
            Submodule (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ) R)) ∧
        Function.Surjective ((residue R).comp
          (algebraMap (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) Λ) R))
